newsitem.title: USA: Cognizant says to take $29.9 mln Q3 charge.
newsitem.headline: Cognizant says to take $29.9 mln Q3 charge.

text.p: Cognizant Corp said Friday it will take a $29.9 million one-time, non-cash write-off in the third quarter related to the sale of its Pilot Software unit for an undisclosed amount.
The company also said it is on target to achieve its 17 to 20 percent earnings per share growth from continuing operations in 1997.
Cognizant said it signed a definitive agreement to sell Pilot Software to Platinum Equity Holdings, a private, Los Angeles-based firm that invests in software-related businesses.
Cognizant did not disclose terms of the transaction, which it said it expects to be completed in August.
Acquired in November 1994 by Dun & Bradstreet Corp, Pilot Software was among the businesses spun-off as Cognizant Corp in November 1996.
